visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Order Is Reversed
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The highest marks should come first (Meena 91), but the program lists the lowest marks first.

solution.explanation: compareTo returns a negative number when this object should come first. Integer.compare(marks, other.marks) is negative for the smaller marks, which gives ascending order. For highest first the arguments are swapped.
